newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Ter Beke 1996 profit drops due charges.
newsitem.headline: Ter Beke 1996 profit drops due charges.

text.p: Twelve months to December 31, 1996 (in millions of Belgian francs unless stated):
NOTE - Ter Beke NV is a Belgian producer of packaged meats and meals.

The company said 1996 results were negatively influenced by a 40 percent rise in pork prices in reaction to the mad cow beef scare, which squeezed margins. In additional, the group incurred extraordinary costs linked to the closure of two factories whose product lines overlapped with those of newly acquired companies.
The company said the outbreak of swine fever in the Netherlands and Germany at the beginning of 1997 had pushed up Belgian pork prices by 15 percent and made forecasting profit difficult.
